caption:
She never takes the lollipop out.
Seedance 2.5 froze this whole rooftop fight.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 29 seconds, 16:9 landscape. Look: live-action Korean high-school drama realism with subtle magic VFX, night, cool cyan-teal and steel-blue grade, soft rooftop floodlight, shallow depth of field, the floor glistening with ice; real actors, not anime. Camera feel: grounded and cinematic: a locked side close-up, a wide side shot of the rooftop, a frontal close-up for the ice trick, and a slowly drifting medium-wide for the finale. Pacing: cool and unhurried; the girl never rushes, every attack is beaten with one small gesture. No blood, no on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos.

CHARACTERS:
- THE ICE GIRL (hero): an East Asian high-school girl, about 17, pale porcelain skin, calm bored deadpan face, chin-length straight pastel lavender-purple bob with soft bangs, a small light-blue fluffy cloud-shaped hair clip on the right side of her head. Uniform: light gray tailored blazer, gray buttoned vest, white shirt, pale-blue ribbon bow tie with long hanging tails, short navy pleated skirt, white knee socks, black loafers. Signature in every shot: a white lollipop stick sticking out of her mouth, and the lavender bob.
- THE BULLIES (a gang of 5 schoolgirls, all with black hair, navy pleated skirts, white socks and white sneakers): (1) long black hair, black padded puffer jacket over a cream knit sweater vest with navy stripe trim; (2) shoulder-length black hair, light gray puffer jacket; (3) long messy black hair, round glasses, black puffer jacket; (4) black hair in a low ponytail, black puffer jacket; (5) long black hair, black jacket and short navy skirt.

LOCATION: a flat concrete school rooftop at night, the whole floor covered in a thin layer of frozen slush and glassy ice with white frost ridges. A tall chain-link fence topped with barbed wire runs along the edge, beyond it a dark city skyline with tiny twinkling lights. In the middle stands a thick blue gym crash mat with a frosted white top. Gray metal air-conditioning units with grilles line the right side. At the far end: a beige concrete stairwell block with a door, a metal staircase climbing its side and a single bright floodlight on a pole.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:05.5) — The kick. Locked-off side-profile medium close-up: the ice girl stands at left facing right, lollipop stick in her mouth. Bully 1 enters from the right and throws a high kick at her head; the ice girl leans her head back just enough and the white sneaker sweeps past her face (00:00.5-00:03.5), a thin frozen water streak hanging in the air diagonally across the frame. At 00:04.0 the ice girl turns and flicks her hand: a burst of icy water splashes into bully 1, who is blasted backward through the air (00:04.5) and lands sprawled on the blue crash mat in the background (00:05.0). The ice girl turns back, expression unchanged.
SHOT 2 (00:05.5-00:10.9) — Black ice. Wide side shot of the rooftop, fence and AC units on the right, bully 1 lying on the mat in the background: bully 2 (gray puffer) charges from the right swinging a long push-broom pole at her head (00:06.0); the ice girl ducks low and touches the floor with one fingertip. MUST SHOW: a square patch of glossy black ice with white cracks spreads out from her fingertip across the floor (00:07.0). Bully 2 steps onto it; the ice girl springs past her as frost coats her blazer shoulder white and ice chunks erupt from the floor at left (00:08.0-00:09.5); bully 2 slips, flies backward and slams into the fence at right (00:10.0), slumping against it.
SHOT 3 (00:10.9-00:15.8) — The frozen pole. Frontal close-up, slightly low angle: the ice girl walks toward camera, looking straight into the lens, the cloud clip visible. Behind her at left, bully 3 (glasses) grimaces and swings a long metal pole with a big round white-and-wood board on its end horizontally at her face (00:12.0); the pole stops right in front of her eyes as she lifts her right hand and points her index finger at it. MUST SHOW: the metal pole freezes into clear crystal ice from the tip back toward the handle (00:13.0-00:14.0), the round board turning to a slab of ice; at 00:15.0 the ice pole cracks into long pieces and at 00:15.5 shatters into a burst of ice chunks right in front of the camera.
SHOT 4 (00:15.8-00:16.8) — The look. Medium close-up: the ice girl tilts her head and stares into the lens, lollipop stick at an angle; behind her bully 3 sits knocked down on the edge of the crash mat, the staircase at left.
SHOT 5 (00:16.8-00:21.9) — The ice pillar. Medium-wide front shot: the ice girl at left, a bully crouched in pain in the background at left; bully 4 swings a snow shovel and hurls a heaping load of snow at her (00:17.0-00:19.0), the snow lump flying past her; bully 4 raises the wooden-handled shovel high and chops down (00:19.5-00:20.0). The ice girl simply opens her hand downward. MUST SHOW: a thick glittering pillar of ice shoots up out of the floor in front of her (00:20.0), growing taller than the frame and launching bully 4 straight up out of the top of the shot (00:21.0-00:21.5).
SHOT 6 (00:21.9-00:29.3) — The finale. Medium-wide shot from the other end of the rooftop, slow gentle push-in: the stairwell block, metal staircase and floodlight at left, several beaten bullies lying on the icy floor. The ice girl stands right of frame, close to camera; bully 5 sprints at her from the background (00:22.0-00:22.5) and lunges; the ice girl leans aside, her hair whipping (00:23.0), and extends her right arm straight out to the side, finger pointing. MUST SHOW: two huge jagged slabs of clear ice burst up from the floor on both sides of bully 5 and lean together into a tall triangle, trapping her between them (00:24.0-00:26.0). At 00:26.5 the ice slabs explode into a giant spray of glittering shards that fills the left half of the frame; ice fragments rain down (00:27.0) and the whole rooftop is left carpeted in broken ice chunks. The ice girl holds her pose, arm still out, lollipop stick in her mouth, and at 00:29.0 calmly turns her head away from the camera.

SOUND: no dialogue. A cool, low pulsing electronic beat throughout. Crunching ice underfoot, a whoosh of the kick, a splash and heavy thud on the mat (shot 1), crackling freeze and ice crunch, a clang on the fence (shot 2), a crystalline freezing crackle and a loud glass-like shatter (shot 3), a whoosh of snow and a deep cracking boom as the pillar rises (shot 5), a grinding crack of the ice slabs, a huge shattering explosion and tinkling shards raining down (shot 6).
prompt_short: Live-action K-drama night rooftop, 16:9: a calm lavender-bob schoolgirl with a lollipop beats 5 bullies with ice magic: black ice, a frozen pole that shatters, an ice pillar, a final explosion of ice shards.
